target: Inventory sync v3 — Variant 1 (Activity block · Stock check list of comparisons · setup inside the product)
primary_task: A Synder user with QuickBooks and Shopify connects their Shopify stores to Inventory Sync, gets each store ready, turns sync on, and later checks what was sent and fixes stock differences.
zones: Overview: Activity · Stock check · Sync · Shopify stores
dialogs (connect, location, update qty, revert, disable)
Stock check tab: list of comparisons → comparison page
observations: Header (?) tooltips (hover + focus): #b-activity: Stock changes from QuickBooks and what happened to them. | #b-sync: Synder reads stock changes from QuickBooks and sends them to the stores that are ready. | #stores-card: Each store receives stock changes at one location once its setup is done. | #b-diff: Every night at 02:30 UTC, Synder compares the stock of each product in QuickBooks and Shopify. Products where the two numbers differ are shown here. Sync sends only changes, so a difference stays until you fix it.

Activity block status tooltips: Held: Not sent. Fix the reason, then click Retry. | Failed: Shopify rejected the change. Click Retry. If it fails again, contact Support. | Pending: Waiting to be sent to Shopify with the next update. | Applied in 24h: Sent. The stock in Shopify was updated.
